newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico hopes to send tax reforms to Congress in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Mexico hopes to send tax reforms to Congress in Q4.

text.p: Mexico hopes to send an initiative to reform the country's tax laws to Congress in October or November, Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz said Wednesday.
"We hope to send an initiative to Congress in October or November..." Ortiz told radio network Radio Red. At the latest, he said, the move would be sent for congressional approval by early next year.
Ortiz said the government was still in talks about the tax reforms. He gave no details of any proposed changes to any forms of taxation.

"We have to have a system that makes people pay a reasonable amount," he said. "But the fundamental aspect (of any reform) is that it is not possible to weaken the fiscal base of the government," he added in an interview with the "Monitor" program anchor Jose Gutierrez Vivo.
